subject: MAP: Fincore acceptance lane — SIG/CAIQ, SOC 2, DPA retention & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincore.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fincore.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fincore MAP: acceptance lane, security gates & retention ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Samir and I put together a tight-first-pass MAP that focuses on the security/compliance acceptance criteria we need to close. High-level items we want to validate up front: 

- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report that covers a control period including mid-2027 and a bridge letter for controls since the report date.
- SIG / CAIQ: a completed CAIQ with control narratives; please mark items as "Provided" vs "Inherited" where applicable.
- DPA / data retention: our initial ask is transactional records retained up to 7 years, anonymized telemetry retained 2 years. We also need clarity on deletion workflows (soft retire vs hard purge) and whether Redwood supports per-customer retention windows for Private deployments.
- Evidence owners & timing: we want an evidence workshop the week of July 19 and target acceptance in ~6 weeks (close by end of August).

Attachments: Fincore-MAP-reqs.pdf (overview of our asks).

Can you confirm two things for us:
1) Who at Redwood will own the SOC 2 artifacts, CAIQ completion, and DPA redlines?
2) Whether you can commit to the 6-week acceptance target and what the main blockers might be?

If it helps, we can send a short MR for the DPA redline after we align on owners.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Platform Security, Fincore

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 18:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fincore MAP: acceptance lane, security gates & retention ask

Thanks Erin — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses and a proposed plan below.

Owners (proposed):
- SOC 2 artifacts & bridge letter: Ben Carter (Security & Compliance)
- CAIQ completion & control narratives: Ben + technical SMEs as needed
- DPA redline (legal / retention carveouts): Laura Bennett (Legal)
- Evidence intake and technical workshop: me (Stephanie) — I will run the intake and map evidence to the MAP lanes.

Feasibility / timeline:
- 6-week acceptance target looks achievable provided we get the workshop in the week of July 19 and Fincore can turn around any DPA redline comments within 5 business days.
- Potential blockers: unusual retention carveouts (e.g., >7y immutable retention), jurisdictional data residency asks that require region-specific hosting, and any controls that require code-level changes to logging/PII handling.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Evidence workshop: propose Tue, Jul 20 10:00–11:30 PT (we'll run a short intro + evidence mapping exercise). Please confirm attendees.
2) We will attach a draft evidence matrix and MAP for your review (attached: proposed-evidence-matrix.csv, MAP-draft-v1.docx).
3) Laura will take your DPA redline once we have agreement on the retention windows; we can run a parallel legal thread to keep the MAP moving.

I can join any legal call if a quick walk-through helps. Ben — can you confirm the SOC 2 availability and whether we can produce a bridge letter?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, GTM Security Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jul 13, 2027 at 15:12 Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincore.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincore.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fincore MAP: acceptance lane, security gates & retention ask

Stephanie / Erin — quick SOC 2 / CAIQ status note from my side.

SOC 2: Redwood completed our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Jan 1 2027 — Jun 30 2027; the report was finalized and issued on Jul 1 2027. We can provide the full report PDF and a short bridge letter that describes changes in our control environment since the report period (standard).

CAIQ: CAIQ is about 85% complete; we've got narrative drafts for Hosting, Access Control, Logging, and Data Lifecycle. We'll finish the remaining items during the intake workshop and mark "Provided" items where evidence is attached.

Retention / private deployments: technically we support per-customer retention windows for Private deployments; the workflow is a hard purge after retention expiry for customer-managed data, but there are exceptions for lawful holds. For Hosted customers we have a standard retention surface that we can map to your buckets — we will put concrete knobs in the proposed-evidence-matrix.

I'll upload the SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter to the shared drive by end of day Wednesday.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincore.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fincore.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 20:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fincore MAP: acceptance lane, security gates & retention ask

Thanks all — that aligns well and gives us confidence. A few clarifying items before the workshop: 

1) DPA retention: Fincore's preference is 7 years for transactional records and 2 years for anonymized telemetry. We are open to negotiating immutable archival carveouts for regulatory needs, but we will need a clause for lawful holds. Laura (Fincore legal) will share a redline tonight; please have Laura (Redwood) confirm whether the per-customer retention knobs you mentioned can be surfaced in the DPA (e.g., Sched A retention table).

2) Evidence delivery: please add the SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter and the current CAIQ draft into the shared drive link you planned. We will use the workshop to mark the CAIQ items as "Provided" / "Not Provided" and capture any tech gaps.

3) Workshop attendees: Erin, Samir (Fincore), Stephanie, Ben, Laura, + 1 engineer (Samir will propose).

I'll review the MAP-draft-v1 and the matrix once they're uploaded. If the DPA redline is minor we can proceed in parallel and still hit the 6-week aim. Samir — please ping if you need a different workshop cadence.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Platform Security, Fincore

Attachments: Fincore-DPA-redline.docx (pending)
